'''V1C-0RY''' was an [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] stationed aboard [[Carrick Station]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] functioned as a business vendor on the station and claimed to have an extensive inventory.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
V1C-0RY appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion. He functioned as a Conquest Rewards vendor.<ref name="SWTOR" />
